items.prompt:
Kinetic energy is the energy of:
A) Position
B) Motion
C) Color
D) Sound only

steps: Kinetic energy is the energy of motion.

items.prompt:
Kinetic energy depends on an object's mass and its:
A) Color
B) Speed
C) Age
D) Name

steps: Both mass and speed affect kinetic energy.

items.prompt:
Two balls move at the same speed. The one with more mass has:
A) Less kinetic energy
B) More kinetic energy
C) No kinetic energy
D) The same kinetic energy

steps: More mass means more kinetic energy at the same speed.

items.prompt:
Two balls have the same mass. The faster ball has:
A) Less kinetic energy
B) More kinetic energy
C) No kinetic energy
D) Negative energy

steps: More speed means more kinetic energy for the same mass.

items.prompt:
Which has a bigger effect on kinetic energy?
A) Doubling the mass
B) Doubling the speed
C) Changing the color
D) Changing the name

steps: Kinetic energy depends on speed squared, so doubling speed matters more.

items.prompt:
A parked car has how much kinetic energy?
A) A lot
B) Some
C) None, because it is not moving
D) Infinite
items.answer: C) None, because it is not moving

steps: With zero speed there is no kinetic energy.

items.prompt:
A car doubles its speed. Its kinetic energy becomes about:
A) The same
B) Twice as much
C) Four times as much
D) Half as much

steps: Kinetic energy depends on the speed squared, so it quadruples.

items.prompt:
Why is a high-speed crash much more dangerous than a low-speed one?
A) Speed does not matter
B) Higher speed means much more kinetic energy released
C) Kinetic energy decreases with speed
D) Mass is the only factor
items.answer: B) Higher speed means much more kinetic energy released

steps: Kinetic energy rises sharply with speed, so more energy is released.
